Thanks Elaine — looping my panel. Quick answers after a look at the slate:

- Debrief owner: I can own score consolidation and the post-interview sync (will submit the scorecard within 6 hours of interview).
- Backups: Marissa can cover backend deep-dive; Karthik can cover system design if needed. Soojin is on-call for behavioral/culture and can step into a 30–45m slot.

Proposed contingency plan (if someone drops within 24h):
1) Swap in Marissa for backend deep-dive (she confirmed she's familiar with the test cases in infra-interview-pack).
2) If system design lead is out, Karthik will do a 60->45m condensed design with the same rubric; candidate still gets the core prompts.
3) If an extra 45m is needed for hiring manager follow-up, Soojin can cover the culture/communication slot and I will run a brief add-on notes call with the hiring manager afterwards.

Drive link to the interview pack with callouts: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cInfraSlate

Elaine — please confirm Samantha's final timezone block and whether TalentBridge can nudge the hiring manager to accept a 14:00–15:00 contiguous slot if we need to compress.
